summary: Iteration 2: Tested new Admin Dashboard feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). All 5 backend pytest cases passed (admin/overview shape+seeds, mechanic toggle persistence + 404, tracking status advance + SMS + stat consistency, invalid tracking id 404). All frontend flows passed: 5 KPI cards render with values matching backend, 6 admin-vehicle-card items, advance/regress buttons enabled/disabled correctly at boundaries (regress disabled for AF-DEMO04 stage 0, advance disabled for AF-DEMO05 stage 4), advancing AF-DEMO04 fires simulated SMS toast and updates KPIs (aguardando 2→1, emManutencao 3→4), mechanic toggle (m1 Disponível→Ocupado, kpi-mecanicos 3/5→2/5), Rastreio link navigates to /rastreio/AF-DEMO01, nav-admin-link visible on home and navigates to /admin.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin panel has no auth guard — per spec it's a demo panel; acceptable for MVP but flag for production.
In-memory MECHANICS list is mutated globally without locking; fine for single-worker demo but not thread-safe for multi-worker deployments.
seed_demo() is idempotent only on empty APPOINTMENTS; if a user creates real appointments before restart, seeds still spawn — acceptable per design.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded AF-DEMO01..AF-DEMO06 appointments and m1..m5 mechanics. Tests restore state after mutation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin feature fully verified. Iteration 1 covered customer/OTP/booking/tracking flows. All admin data-testids present and working: admin-dashboard, kpi-em-manutencao/aguardando/prontos/mecanicos/servicos, admin-vehicle-card, btn-admin-advance-{id}, btn-admin-regress-{id}, btn-admin-track-{id}, btn-toggle-mechanic-m1..m5, mechanic-item, service-agenda-item, nav-admin-link.
